meta.title: Eris: a Discord-style Matrix client
meta.description: Eris is a Matrix client with servers, channels, direct messages, friends and voice calls in a Discord-style layout. For the web, Windows, Linux and Android.
hero.tagline: Servers, channels, DMs and voice chat on the open Matrix network.
showcase.title: A layout you already know
showcase.body: A server rail, channel lists, chat and a member list. Every conversation runs on Matrix.
showcase.chat.name: Chat
showcase.chat.body: Files, images and audio in the timeline, with @ mentions and # channel links.
showcase.voice.name: Voice
showcase.voice.body: Group voice channels run on MatrixRTC and LiveKit.
showcase.friends.name: Friends
showcase.friends.body: A friends list, direct messages and a right-click menu on every row.
showcase.switcher.name: Quick switcher
showcase.switcher.body: Press Ctrl+K and jump to a chat, a channel or a server.
showcase.roles.name: Permissions
showcase.roles.body: Choose the role each action needs, channel by channel.
showcase.login.name: Sign in
showcase.login.body: Type your Matrix ID. Eris finds your homeserver.
features.title: What Eris does
features.homeserver.title: Any homeserver
features.homeserver.body: Sign in with an account from matrix.org or from your own server. Eris finds the homeserver from your ID.
features.spaces.title: Servers and channels
features.spaces.body: Matrix spaces appear as servers with text and voice channels. Create, join and invite from the app.
features.dms.title: DMs and friends
features.dms.body: Direct messages, group DMs and a friends list with online status.
features.timeline.title: Attachments and mentions
features.timeline.body: Send files, images and audio. Mention people with @ and link channels with #.
features.voice.title: Voice calls
features.voice.body: 1:1 calls use Matrix VoIP. Group voice channels use MatrixRTC and LiveKit.
features.roles.title: Roles and permissions
features.roles.body: Set admins and moderators, choose who can do what, and manage members and invites.
features.themes.title: Themes
features.themes.body: {count, plural, one {# theme} other {# themes}} with dark and light modes. Eris can also follow your system setting.
features.input.title: Keyboard and mouse
features.input.body: Discord-style shortcuts that you can rebind, and a custom right-click menu on every item.
features.languages.title: Languages
features.languages.body: {count, plural, one {# interface language} other {# interface languages}}, with a right-to-left layout for Persian.
themes.title: Pick a look
themes.body: Every theme has a dark and a light mode. Eris can switch with your system setting.
download.title: Get Eris
download.body: Installers are on GitHub Releases. Pick your platform.
download.web.body: Run the web client from the source code.
matrix.title: Built on Matrix. Open source.
matrix.protocol.title: An open standard
matrix.protocol.body: Matrix is an open protocol for real-time communication. No single company owns the network.
matrix.homeserver.title: A server you choose
matrix.homeserver.body: Your account lives on a homeserver. Use a public one or run your own.
matrix.interop.title: Works with other clients
matrix.interop.body: Your rooms are the same in Element and other Matrix clients. Use them side by side.
matrix.source.title: Open source
matrix.source.body: Eris is built with Svelte and Tauri. The source code is public on GitHub.
faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.what.a: Eris is a client for the Matrix network. It shows your spaces, rooms and direct messages in a Discord-style layout.
faq.account.q: Do I need a new account?
faq.account.a: No. Sign in with the Matrix account you already have. If you have none, create one on matrix.org or another homeserver first.
faq.price.a: Yes. Eris is free, and the source code is public on GitHub.
faq.platforms.a: Windows, Linux and Android have installers. The same client also runs in a web browser.
faq.voice.a: 1:1 calls use Matrix VoIP. Group voice channels use MatrixRTC with LiveKit, so your homeserver must provide a LiveKit service.
faq.interop.q: Can I talk to people who use Element?
faq.interop.a: Yes. Everyone on Matrix shares one network, whatever client or homeserver they use.
faq.encryption.a: Not yet. Eris cannot read or send messages in encrypted rooms at this time.
cta.title: Start chatting on Matrix
cta.body: Download the latest release from GitHub.
footer.disclaimer: Eris is not affiliated with Discord or the Matrix.org Foundation.
